## 3025c0637069

**Reproduced defect: five portable task tests do not load the generator.** The
audit assignment pins generator SHA-256
`539567e401dbe75e9f80e8a32af80fc91583c39b891a8b333894b0a225f1219b`.
The supported staged task-test command completed with exit 1: 5 tests passed and
5 failed. Every failure is a `FileNotFoundError` for a path of the form
`.../generators/3025c0637069/puzzle_generators/per_puzzle/3025c0637069/generator.py`.

The test file sets `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`, which is already
the task directory, then appends the legacy full runtime path. Consequently the
canonical reproduction, deterministic generation, exact override, mutation, and
lesson-identifiability tests never execute in the portable snapshot. Evidence:
`checks/audit/3025c0637069-task-tests/result.json` and
`checks/audit/3025c0637069-task-tests/checks/task_tests.xml`.

A task-local loader should honor `GENERATOR_UNDER_TEST` or fall back to
`ROOT / "generator.py"`. I did not modify this audit target. Separately, its
semantic stage returned an advisory rather than green because the
`noncontiguous_row_texture` witness has no rival claim; I did not treat that as
a proven semantic defect.
